English.Char_Desc_2000:
CleanGeek clears the caches, temporary files and Windows Update leftovers that build up on a Windows machine.
It shows you the number first: every item reports what it would recover before anything is removed, and nothing goes without a plain-English confirmation. Only caches and temporary files are ticked by default; everything with a cost is opt-in.
It also lists everything installed, handing the uninstall to the publisher's own uninstaller, and every startup entry with a note on which ones to leave alone.
There is deliberately no registry cleaner. There is no scheduled deletion and no command line that can trigger one. It does not hunt for leftovers after an uninstall, because guessing is how a cleaner removes the wrong folder.
No account, no ads, no bundled offers. Windows 10 1809 or later, 64-bit. Free to use, including at work.
